name: robots/fmdazhar__mujoco_sim
title: mujoco_sim UR5e peg-in-hole (ur5ePegInHoleGymEnv_easy-v0)
intro: mujoco_sim UR5e peg-in-hole (ur5ePegInHoleGymEnv_easy-v0), adapted from fmdazhar/mujoco_sim. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
